response.overview: QuickBooks Desktop is widely used by businesses to manage accounting, bookkeeping, invoices, expenses, and financial records. To continue using its subscription-based features and services, users need to keep their QuickBooks Desktop and Payroll subscriptions active. If your QuickBooks subscription is about to expire, has expired, or your payment has failed, renewing or reactivating your subscription can help restore access to the services included in your plan.
